question: Build an SVM classification model to predict the binary outcome label using a 70/30 train-test split. Evaluate performance on both training and test sets and generate an ROC curve with AUC values for both sets.

expected_output.guidelines: Per-class precision, recall, and F1 must match within +/-0.05; row and column order may differ.
ROC curves for both training and test sets with per-curve AUC annotations on TPR vs. FPR axes; colors, fonts, and layout may differ.
Training and test accuracy and AUC values must each match within +/-0.05; row and column order may differ.
